theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenVar_exists_unit_field_eqOn_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (C V : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn N), IsCompact C → IsOpen V → C ⊆ V → ContinuousOn f C → (∀ x ∈ C, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, g x = f x
